covers.desc: Be able to verify the conditions (linear relationship, constant standard deviation, independence, normality of residuals) required for inference about the slope of a regression model.
Be able to construct and interpret a confidence interval for the slope of a regression model, including margin of error, standard error, and the effect of sample size on interval width.
Be able to identify hypotheses, calculate the t test statistic and p-value, and justify a claim for a significance test about the slope of a regression model.

Be able to identify the slope, y-intercept, r-squared, standard deviation of residuals, and standard error of the slope from computer regression output, and describe the association using predicted (non-deterministic) language.
Be able to select and justify the appropriate inference procedure (confidence interval or significance test) for a scenario involving the slope of a regression model.
